answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a barrier against Sybil attacks by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. An attacker must accumulate a massive stake to influence the tide of consensus, effectively pricing them out of malicious control. Like a structural terrace built upon immutable ledgers, this economic barrier protects the system's opal integrity. By tying influence to wealth rather than pseudonymous identities, the system renders the creation of fake nodes prohibitively expensive.
